name: Gradaly v3.0.2
title: Gradaly v3.0.2
notes:
### ✨ New Features & Improvements
- **Geometric Copy Alignment (2D RANSAC)**: Automatically detect and correct printer scaling, rotation, and scanner offsets across student copies relative to the reference canvas, with instant cancellation support during per-copy calibration.
- **1-Click PDF Page Reordering & Rotation**: Swap adjacent pages directly from the PDF viewer separator or open the thumbnail grid modal to reorder and rotate pages (`+90°`, `180°`, `-90°`) for one or multiple copies.
- **Filter by Selected Copies in Grading**: Added a symmetric 2×2 filter bar (`All`, `Selected (N)`, `To grade`, `Graded`) and reorganized the copies list header for a cleaner workspace.
- **Unified Solutionnaire & AI Rubric Editing**: Unified `Solutionnaire` terminology across the UI, redesigned the criteria toolbar with a full-width *Design / Edit with AI* button, and enabled direct conversational editing of existing rubrics.
- **Enhanced OCR & Automatic Student Matching**: Rendered identification zone crops at 2.5× resolution (180 DPI), added multiset canvas token subtraction, improved spaced student ID reassembly, supported `"Last, First"` CSV rosters, and preserved live matching progress across tab switches.
